title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Latest RemoteOK inventory validated for target-family scope and Canadian regional eligibility. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: Rechecked September 19, 2026 — no eligible target-family postings this run.

notes_sections.heading: Regional exclusions
items: Engineering Manager/TLM, Platform — Harper (posted September 11): owns infrastructure, developer productivity, SRE, and production support, but requires relocation to San Francisco and 5 days/week on-site — outside Marc's reachable range. Not scored. View posting. (Repeat exclusion from the 2026-09-18 run — still present in the current inventory window.)

notes_sections.heading: Could not validate
items: Golang Kubernetes Engineer — Arango (posted September 16, plausible Platform-family fit): the API description is truncated to marketing boilerplate and an anti-spam instruction with no real requirements; the canonical detail page also would not expose full requirements or confirmed regional eligibility without a Premium unlock. Not scored per the validation rule — a snippet is not sufficient. View posting.

notes_sections.heading: Scope exclusions
items: Operations Engineer II — AWeber (posted August 4, tagged 'ops'/'sys admin'): the listing content is templated marketing copy for AWeber's own email-marketing product with no technical requirements resembling an infrastructure/operations role — treated as a corrupted or mismatched listing, not a genuine target-family posting.
The remaining 96 API jobs were unrelated roles: sales, finance, customer support, application/product development, data entry, HR, and general operations.

notes_sections.heading: Search limitations
items: The public API returned 99 job objects; 19 were dated within the preferred 14-day window (since 2026-09-05).
The API is a latest-inventory feed, not a dedicated keyword-search endpoint — the full returned inventory was reviewed for target titles, tags, and description signals.
No eligible, unclear, or known-pipeline target-family role surfaced this run. No CAPTCHA, verification page, or write-side action occurred.

Several RemoteOK postings scored in the 2026-08-25 run (Akuity, DoiT, Lemon.io, Livepeer, Shakepay — all still New in applications.md) have since rolled off the API's ~100-item latest-inventory window and could not be rechecked for freshness this run; they remain in applications.md pending user review via the review skill, not this discovery pass.
